items.headline: Patagonia, Puma Prove Recycled Polyester Can Scale Commercially
items.blurb: Designers can now source sustainable performance fabrics at industrial volumes without compromising quality standards.

items.headline: Rheom Materials Expands Into Footwear With Sustainable Components
items.blurb: Designers can now source lab-made alternatives to traditional plastics and leather, reducing environmental impact without redesigning silhouettes.

items.headline: Kraig Labs Delivers First Spider Silk Yarn to Major Sports Brand
items.blurb: Bio-engineered silk offers designers a sustainable alternative with enhanced performance properties for next-gen athletic wear.

items.headline: Bangladesh Polyester Maker Secures $50M to Quadruple Output
items.blurb: Design teams may see improved polyester availability and potentially better pricing as production capacity expands significantly.

items.headline: Startup Unveils Circular Packaging Solution for Recyclable Poly Bags
items.blurb: Designers can now specify packaging that feeds into closed-loop systems, reducing waste and supporting sustainability commitments.
